user_fields.description: These fields are returned, unmodified, in the user_fields section of the response.

Status.description: Reports the success or failure of the match attempt.

Status.Code.description: Reason for failure, if there is one.

Status.Description.description: Description of the problem, if there is one.

Confidence.description: The level of confidence assigned to the address being returned.

MultipleMatches.description: Indicates which address component had multiple matches.

CouldNotValidate.description: Mentions the address component that could not be validated, in case no match is found.

CountryLevel.description: The category of address matching available.

AddressFormat.description: The type of address data being returned.

AddressLine1.description: The first line of the validated address.

AddressLine2.description: The second line of the validated address.

AddressLine3.description: The third line of the validated address.

AddressLine4.description: The fourth line of the validated address.

StateProvince.description: The validated state or province abbreviation.

PostalCode.description: The validated ZIP Code or postal code.

PostalCode.AddOn.description: The 4-digit add-on part of the ZIP Code.

Country.description: The country in the format determined by what you selected.

AdditionalInputData.description: Input data that could not be matched to a particular address component.

FirmName.description: The validated firm or company name.

ApartmentLabel.description: Apartment designator (such as STE or APT).

ApartmentLabel.Input.description: Apartment designator (such as STE or APT).

Country.Input.description: Country. Format is determined by what you selected in OutputCountryFormat.

FirmName.Input.description: The validated firm or company name.

HouseNumber.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for HouseNumber.

LeadingDirectional.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for LeadingDirectional.

Street.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for Street.

StreetName.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for StreetName.

StreetName.Alias.Type.description: The field-level result indicator for StreetName Alias.

StreetSuffix.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for StreetSuffix.

TrailingDirectional.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for TrailingDirectional.

ApartmentLabel.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for ApartmentLabel.

ApartmentNumber.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for ApartmentNumber.

ApartmentLabel2.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for ApartmentLabel2.

ApartmentNumber2.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for ApartmentNumber2.

RRHC.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for RRHC.

RRHC.Type.description: The field-level result indicator for RRHC Type.

POBox.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for POBox.

City.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for City.

StateProvince.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for StateProvince.

PostalCode.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for PostalCode.

PostalCodeCity.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for PostalCodeCity.

AddressRecord.Result.description: The field-level result indicator for AddressRecord.

PostalCode.Source.description: The field-level result indicator for PostalCode Source.

PostalCode.Type.description: Indicates the type of postal code returned.

Country.Result.description: The validated firm or company name.

FirmName.Result.description: Indicates if the firm name got validated.

StreetNamePreferredAlias.Result.description: Indicates the result of preferred alias processing.

StreetNameAbbreviatedAlias.Result.description: Indicates the result of abbreviated alias processing.

AddressLine5.description: The fifth line of the validated address.

AddressQuality.description: A two character code indicating overall quality of the resulting address.

Deliverability.description: An estimate of confidence that an item mailed or shipped to this address would be successfully delivered.

AddressType.description: A single letter code that indicates the type of address.

Locality.description: A locality is a village in rural areas or it may be a suburb in urban areas.

ChangeScore.description: A value of 0 and 100 that reflects how much the address has changed to make it valid.

Suburb.description: The validated firm or company name.

BlockAddress.description: It is the formatted address, as it would appear on a physical mail piece.

Latitude.description: Seven-digit number in degrees, calculated to four decimal places.

Longitude.description: Seven-digit number in degrees, calculated to four decimal places.
